keyword: site voltage on an electric pump inquiry

title.en: Send Site Voltage When the Xingtai Electric Sheet Leaves It Blank
title.zh: 邢台电动页把电压留空时，请发送现场电压

description.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints 380 V on B500S-83D and on several sprayers. Most electric trailer sheets do not print voltage or frequency. The inquiry still asks for both.
description.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台的 B500S-83D 和若干喷涂机上印了 380 V。多数电动拖泵页不印电压或频率。询盘仍然要求这两项。

h1.en: Your Voltage Is a Site Fact, Not a Missing Catalogue Cell
h1.zh: 你的电压是现场事实，不是被漏掉的目录格

directAnswer.en: When you order an electric pump from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai, check whether that page prints voltage. B500S-83D prints 380 V. M9 prints 380 V / 50 Hz. Type 511 and the hydraulic sprayers print 380 V. Electric 20, Electric 40, Electric 60 and Electric 80 do not print a voltage cell on the lists used here. Do not copy 380 V onto those pump orders as if the sheet said it. Do send the site voltage and frequency, because the factory’s inquiry line asks for them. Write to [/en/contact/](/en/contact/). No price is printed.
directAnswer.zh: 向河北品锦机械（邢台）订电动泵时，先看那一页是否印了电压。B500S-83D 印 380 V。M9 印 380 V / 50 Hz。511 和液压喷涂机印 380 V。电动20、电动40、电动60和电动80在此处使用的列表上没有电压格。不要把 380 V 抄进这些泵的订单，好像表上写过一样。但请发送现场电压和频率，因为工厂的询盘口径要求这两项。写到 [/zh/contact/](/zh/contact/)。没有印价格。

body.en: M9 prints 50 Hz with 380 V. The trailer lists used here generally do not. Send frequency even when the page is silent.
body.zh: M9 把 50 Hz 和 380 V 印在一起。此处使用的拖泵列表一般不印。即使页面沉默，也请发送频率。

heading.en: Diesel orders skip the motor voltage
heading.zh: 柴油订单不写电机电压

body.en: A diesel page needs the engine line and the word diesel. It does not need a pretended motor voltage.
body.zh: 柴油页需要发动机行和“柴油”二字。它不需要一个假装的电机电压。

body.en: Do not invent kilowatts for a generator. State whether one will be provided and what voltage and frequency it holds.
body.zh: 不要编造发电机的千瓦。请写明是否提供，以及它稳住的电压和频率。

question.en: Is every Xingtai electric pump 380 V on the sheet?
question.zh: 每台邢台电动泵的表上都是 380 V 吗？

answer.en: No. Only the pages that print it.

question.zh: 电动80的订单应该写 380 V 吗？

answer.en: Only as your site fact, labelled as such, not as a cell from that page.
answer.zh: 只能作为你的现场事实，并标明是现场事实，而不是那一页上的格子。

answer.en: It prints 220/380 V on the sprayer page. That is not a trailer-pump cell.
answer.zh: 喷涂页印 220/380 V。那不是拖泵格子。

question.en: Who confirms the supply is enough?

answer.en: Xingtai, after you send voltage, frequency and the motor kilowatts of the path.
answer.zh: 邢台，在你发送电压、频率和该路径的电机千瓦之后。
